cohort: The study included 69 women with singleton breech pregnancies who underwent ECV at a single institution between January 2011 and December 2024, excluding those with abnormal placental location, fetal growth restriction, prior cesarean delivery, or missing data.
finding: The absence of fetal buttock engagement and the absence of a nuchal cord were independently associated with successful external cephalic version.
birth_weight: Estimated fetal body weight > 2500g was investigated as a potential factor for ECV success; actual birth weights of the cohort were not reported.
gest_age: Gestational age at ECV was a factor reviewed in the study; specific gestational age ranges for the cohort are not provided.
